subject: Fixing the bench tomorrow
text: The garden bench needs finishing before Sunday, so I will come by at ten with the missing bolts. I have replacement boards in my shed, but the frame remains loose near the back legs, so the visit cannot wait. Please leave the gate unlocked if you are away, and set the toolbox on the porch. If rain comes, I will start in the garage and work outside only when it stays dry. Do not move the chair or planters, since they block the path. I will knock first, wait ten minutes if there is no answer, and stay about two hours. At the end, I will sweep and put waste by the bin. I will message if the repair takes longer than expected.
